proposal.reason: Primary change is in enqueue/launch planning: regular plans now launch with driver extra params carrying argument buffer pointer and actual length, and the runtime kernel-arg capacity/monitor storage is expanded to 4 KiB. kernels is also required because collective kernel signatures/types are changed from 1 KiB to 4 KiB argument storage (device-kernel interface impact). symmetric is additionally required because symmetric scheduling/allocation logic is substantively adjusted to keep its grouping budget capped at 1 KiB and to change multi-task args lifetime/ownership handling.
